capabilities: Edit Markdown notes visually without exposing raw syntax
Toggle between Obsidian's Markdown editor and the rich text editor via command or toolbar icon
Provide a mobile toolbar above the keyboard with a swipe-down gesture to dismiss it
Replicate Obsidian's look and feel inside the editor
disambiguation: Despite the name, it edits Markdown files; the text produced is pure Markdown, not a rich text file format.
extras: The author says the plugin covers only his own mobile workflows and may lack features other users want; he welcomes forks and contributions.
intentEvidence: While I do like the control you get from the regular WYSIWYG editor of obsidian, it makes it quite a hassle when trying to edit text quickly.
motivation: The author built it because editing text quickly on a phone was cumbersome; deleting a checklist item forced deleting all its symbols, which MDXEditor reduces to one backspace.
problem: Editing raw Markdown is cumbersome, especially on mobile, where simple actions like deleting a checklist item require removing all the syntax characters.

relations.evidence: The plugin is using a customized version of MDXEditor.

summary: Rich text (WYSIWYG) editor view for Markdown notes, built on a customized MDXEditor, so you edit visually without seeing raw Markdown syntax.
